req.title: Create new player
req.statement: The system shall create a player and respond with HTTP 201 when POST /players/ receives a valid Player payload.
expected_outcomes: Location header points to new resource

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 201 on POST /players/ with a valid payload, a Location header pointing to the new resource, and appropriate 4xx/5xx on error paths. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — valid full payload yields 201 + Location + correct response body fields; (2) EP positive minimal — only required fields yields 201; (3) NEG — missing required field yields 422; (4) NEG — duplicate squad_number yields 409; (5) BVA — squad_number boundary at 0 (edge integer); (6) DT — empty body yields 422; (7) STC — create then verify Location header resolves to the new resource. Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201
preconditions: Database pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows (squad numbers 1-26)
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a complete valid PlayerRequestModel payload using squad_number=99
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), firstName='Tester', lastName='McTest', squadNumber=99, position='Goalkeeper'
trace: R-PLAYER-006: system shall respond HTTP 201 when POST /players/ receives valid payload
R-PLAYER-006: Location header points to new resource
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Tester",
        "middleName": "Mid",
        "lastName": "McTest",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Test League",
        "starting11": False
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert r.headers["location"] == "/players/squadnumber/99"
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Tester"
    assert body["lastName"] == "McTest"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert body["abbrPosition"] == "GK"
    assert body["team"] == "Test FC"
    assert body["league"] == "Test League"
    assert body["starting11"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    import uuid
    uuid.UUID(body["id"])

test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_player_missing_required_field_returns_422
actions: POST /players/ with payload missing required 'position' field
expected: Response body contains validation error detail
trace: R-PLAYER-006 error pathway: HTTP 4xx on client error
PlayerRequestModel requires position; omitting it triggers Pydantic validation failure
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_missing_required_field_returns_422():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "No",
        "lastName": "Position",
        "squadNumber": 77
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    errors = body["detail"]
    assert isinstance(errors, list)
    assert len(errors) >= 1
    fields = [e["loc"][-1] for e in errors if "loc" in e]
    assert "position" in fields

test_post_player_missing_required_field_returns_422()

tests.name: test_post_player_location_header_resolves_to_new_resource
preconditions: Database pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows (squad numbers 1-26)
Squad number 88 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=88 to create a new player
GET the URL from the Location header to verify the resource exists
expected: GET on Location URL returns HTTP 200
GET response body squadNumber equals 88 and firstName matches posted value
trace: R-PLAYER-006: Location header points to new resource — state transition from non-existent to created
STC: system transitions from no-player state to player-exists state; GET confirms transition
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_location_header_resolves_to_new_resource():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Lionel",
        "lastName": "NewPlayer",
        "squadNumber": 88,
        "position": "Left Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "LW",
        "team": "New FC",
        "league": "New League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    location = post_r.headers["location"]
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/88"
    get_r = client.get(location)
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    body = get_r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 88
    assert body["firstName"] == "Lionel"
    assert body["lastName"] == "NewPlayer"
    assert body["position"] == "Left Winger"
    assert body["starting11"] == True

test_post_player_location_header_resolves_to_new_resource()
